profile.headline: Software Engineer at Amazon
profile.summary: Learning about new technology is my passion. I inspire to be innovative.  Currently working on gaining new software engineering experience.

positions.title: Lead Technologist
positions.description:
- Worked on creating API for other developers to use government calculations systems to simulate real-world what-ifs scenarios
- Helped client support its customers by using technologies like Spring Boot, MongoDB, React, and Docker. 
- Grew team from 3 to 10+ front and backend developers to help support client 
- Made software and process decisions to make the project successful.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on transforming workplaces with innovative technology

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Research & Development:
• Worked on researching and implementing parallel computing technology for GPU database
• Helped add to performance increase by implementing code to adjust algorithms based off systems hardware
• Developed frontend for database that helped users with analyzing data using graphical representations
• Reversed engineered large legacy code bases and refactored code as needed
• Collaborated with team members during development  to perform unit testing and bug fixing using Mercurial and Bugzilla
• Presented working code to management and CEO of company

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description:
• Analyze data for scope to save  project and client money
• Created innovative ways of status reporting thus reducing overhead
• Ensured data accuracy before and after reporting data reports to VPs and CIO of client
• Automated repeatable processes using VB-Script and Macros  making team more efficient 
• Tracked task of  Work Streams/Departments for large scale data migration making sure deadlines were met

positions.title: System Admin Intern
positions.description:
• Reimaged and updated Computers with proper software for direct work on contract.
• Maintain multi-media lab area and trouble shot any technical issues.
• Created Virtual Machines for SharePoint users.
• Worked on getting tools for Android and iPhone application development.
• One of the administrators of the ESIIL Network- added and deleted users and computers from Domain.
